newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq defies Dow slide but record trend in peril.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq defies Dow slide but record trend in peril.

text.p: Technology stocks held fast against an onslaught of late-day selling in the broader market with the Nasdaq Composite Index ekeing out a small gain to close above the 1300 mark for the first time ever.
A late wave of selling wiped out nearly all of its earlier gains, with the Nasdaq squeaking out a gain to close up 0.55 or 0.04 percent to 1300.37, another all-time record high.
But the seven-session streak of new highs could be in peril after today's onslaught. The Dow closed off 79 points.

"Everything started coming in for sale ... We stayed up, but we definitely would have been in negative territory if there had been a little more time left," said Patrick Davis, head of OTC trading at Salomon Brothers.
"You've got to imagine (that) unless we get some kind of good news there's going to (be) follow through on the down side tomorrow. But we've had a huge run," he said.
Advancing issues outpaced losers by 2385 to 1938 on unofficial volume of about 697 million shares.
Most-active Informix Corp shares dropped 1 to 25-3/8. U.S. Robotics Corp lost 7-1/8 to 73-3/4 after an analyst cautioned the modem maker may face a weak quarter.
